blocks.label: greedy feasibility checker
blocks.py:
def feasible(cap):                      # can we split into <= k parts?
    students, cur = 1, 0
    for p in pages:
        if p > cap: return False
        if cur + p > cap: students += 1; cur = p
        else: cur += p
    return students <= k
# bisect: lo=max(pages), hi=sum(pages); find FIRST true

sections.title: Partition bisection — median of two sorted arrays

blocks.md: The MAANG boss fight. Median splits merged order at half-point; find a CUT i in shorter array such that left-parts contain exactly ⌈(m+n)/2⌉ elements AND every left value ≤ every right value across BOTH arrays. Binary search the cut.

blocks.label: partition search core
blocks.py:
half = (m + n + 1) // 2
lo, hi = 0, m                            # cut search in SHORTER array
while lo <= hi:
    i = (lo + hi) // 2; j = half - i
    Al = A[i-1] if i else float('-inf'); Ar = A[i] if i<m else float('inf')
    Bl = B[j-1] if j else float('-inf'); Br = B[j] if j<n else float('inf')
    if Al <= Br and Bl <= Ar:            # VALID partition
        return max(Al, Bl) if (m+n)%2 else (max(Al,Bl)+min(Ar,Br))/2
    hi = i - 1 if Al > Br else lo = i + 1 if False else (lo := i + 1)
